messages:
noah: Quick design sync: updated prototype where the p95 line can be pinned to the heatmap (sticky annotation) vs keeping it only in the legend. Putting this here to capture tradeoffs before I finalize specs. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxx/latency-pin
mei: Sticky annotation seems useful when scanning long time ranges. Users often lose the p95 when zooming out. But it will overlap dense heatmap rows — needs a collapse affordance.
devon: Could we collapse the sticky annotation into a small pill that expands on hover/focus? That reduces occlusion.
rahul: If it expands on hover, ensure keyboard users can expand via Enter/Space and focus lands inside expanded content. Also consider exposing a keyboard shortcut to toggle p95 visibility (e.g., "k" when chart focused).
accessibility-bot: a11y check: interactive pill must have aria-expanded and a visible focus ring. Contrast of pill text should meet 4.5:1 against heatmap backdrop.
noah: Good notes. Copy inside pill when collapsed: currently "p95: 312ms" with a chevron. On expand we show small actions: [Toggle sampling] [Go to sampling settings]. Thoughts on wording?
mei: "Toggle sampling" is ambiguous. Maybe "Share latency samples" or "Enable sampling" depending on state. Show current state: "Sampling: on (1 in 100)".
devon: UX: expansion should show a tiny sparkline for context and a three-dot menu for advanced options (open modal to change sample rate). Avoid putting the slider in the expansion to keep it lightweight.
rahul: Modal approach is better for focus management. Modal title: "Latency sampling settings". Include accessible labels for the slider and an estimate line: "Est. events per month: ~{n}".
noah: Implementation constraint: we must not display raw counts or sample estimates for enterprise customers who disable telemetry. Product to confirm.
mei: Placement note: when heatmap uses dark theme the pill needs a subtle backdrop (semi-opaque) to avoid blending into colors. Use token var: --surface-elev-2.
devon: Performance nit: sticky annotation must not trigger reflow on every mousemove. Use transform for animations and debounce repositioning.
accessibility-bot: a11y reminder: time-series annotations should be reachable in DOM order. If pinned visually over the chart, add skip-links or use aria-roledescription="annotation".
noah: Good point. I'll include an aria-roledescription and ensure the annotation appears in the accessible chart legend order.
mei: Copy micro-nit: instead of "p95" label use "p95 latency" for clarity in tooltips. Some users unfamiliar with percentiles may misread.
devon: Also add a short help tooltip: "What is p95?" linking to docs. Keep it dismissible and reachable by keyboard.
rahul: For keyboard shortcut discoverability show a small hint on hover/expand: "Press 'k' to toggle p95" and include it in the keyboard shortcuts modal (global shortcuts).
noah: Next steps: i'll update figma to show collapsed pill + expanded view + modal flow, include aria attributes and focus flow notes. devon, can you review the animation approach? rahul, can product confirm telemetry visibility rules for enterprise?
mei: also propose we test sticky vs legend-only in a small usability study (5 participants) to validate discoverability and occlusion complaints.
noah: Agreed. I'll add that to the PRD. Thanks everyone :sparkles:
